request.user:
Write a complete C program (C11) that solves the following problem. Reply with the code only.

Sort integers.

The first line contains n (0 <= n <= 100000). The second line contains n integers; each fits in a
signed 32-bit int (-2147483648 .. 2147483647).

Print the n integers in non-decreasing order on one line, separated by single spaces, followed by a
newline. When n = 0 print just a newline. The solution must run in O(n log n) time.

Sample input:
5
3 1 4 1 5

Sample output:
1 1 3 4 5
